explanation: Induction on n: (number of strict steps below n) + finrank R_0 <= finrank R_n, since a strict step R_t < R_{t+1} increases finrank by at least one (Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt) and a non-strict step keeps it (Submodule.finrank_mono). Conclude with finrank R_n <= finrank V and convert the set to a filtered Finset.range.
